title: THE BIBLE : THE BOOK OF OUR FATHERS | Traumatizing Knees Of Pressure!! Leviticus 26 (Part 4)

sense.text:
The Lord shall smite thee with madness: So again, let me just reiterate the point that I was making with all of the trauma that we've been experiencing in this country, and how has been forced upon us. We have been put into a situation where we feel like we cannot escape the trauma, so therefore we begin to justify it, so that we can cope and live. So I want to talk about the demons that we fight against when we are tormented by the fact that we are catching so much hell.

The Lord shall smite thee with madness: So as a result of us breaking the laws of God. We know about this. Deuteronomy the 28th chapter records the blessings if we would have kept the commandments of God, and it also records the curses if we broke the laws of God. The commandments was given to the nation of Israel on a conditional basis. If we would have kept the laws of the Lord, we'd have been blessed above all nations. If we broke the laws of God, we would have been cursed underneath all of the nations, and this is what's happened. These are some of the curses that I'm going to bring out now, and this particular curse that we're reading about here deals with the psychological trauma that we've been going through, and that's what I want to expound on just a little bit.

The Lord shall smite thee with madness: The Lord, as a punishment, the Lord shall smite the Israelites with madness. Madness means craziness. He will smite us with us being out of our mind. In other words, we're not the people who God made us. We are like an outside being, as opposed to what God made us. We are out of our minds.

And blindness: He would blind us. He said that he would also smite us with spiritual blindness, with mental blindness, meaning that we can't even see obvious things, like we're thinking that we're getting justice in the system. That's a level of blindness there. We think that this is a utopia. We think this is actually God's utopia. Nothing could be worse than God's utopia than this place and the evil that has been done here, but they have given us all rose-colored glasses and made us believe that this is really about God's utopia, even though you read the Lord's prayer. The Lord's prayer says thy kingdom come, thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven. That's telling you that this is not the kingdom of the Most High, and the Lord is going to destroy this kingdom so that he can set up his kingdom, so that the kingdom of God can be on earth as it is in heaven. So that's letting you know that this is not the place for God's utopia, and he's specifically talking about this country. That's the country Babylon the Great, is on God's hit list.

And blindness: But we are so blind, we actually think that this is a nation under God, like God is showing favor to this country. The only reason why this country is getting any level of favor is because you Israelites are here, and I'ma prove my statement just by what I'm about to say right now, because the only reason why this country has not been destroyed by God is because the Israelites are still here. Let me prove that. Watch this.

The Lord shall smite thee with madness: So this is what happened to us, and the reason why our people are so mad now is because they have not gotten this knowledge. They have not gotten this gospel of repentance that would get them out of that. We were mad at one point, so this truth is for them.

And astonishment of heart: The way we felt. We are the greatest nation on this planet earth. Now we are less than. We are the absolute bottom. Nobody respects us, and we are the Lord's people. That's what you call an astonishment.

And thou shalt grope at noonday: The Bible says it is high time for our people to awake out of sleep. That's what this talk about here.

And thou shalt grope at noonday: We shall grope at noonday. Noonday is when the sun is straight up in the sky. You shouldn't be groping around in the noonday when the sun is way up there. Noonday mean the sun is up. You ain't supposed to be still sleeping, still out of your mind, crazy, but because of our refusal to repent, the Most High said that when it's sunny and bright, you're gonna be walking around as a dead man.

As the blind gropeth in darkness: The sun is up there and we're groping around like it's black outside. That's what it's like: a blind man in darkness. Even just as a blind man, first of all, he can't even see, but you put a blind man in darkness. That's why the Bible used the word gross darkness to people, because our blindness is super blind.

As the blind gropeth in darkness: As a blind man, he can't see already, but you put the blind man that can't see, put him in darkness. That's how we're groping, and guess what, the Lord is saying that the sun is way up there. You can't get no brighter part of the day than that.

And thou shalt grope at noonday: And thou, you Israelites that refuse to keep my commandments and you don't want to repent, you shall grope in darkness.

And thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: And we shall not prosper. We're thinking we're going to get justice. We're not going to get any justice in this land until you return to the Most High. The Most High is going to give us the proper justice, is going to give us the proper therapy. Therapy, you're not going to get no therapy in this system.

And no man shall save thee: No man shall redeem us. That's the same word. Redeemed means the same word in Deuteronomy 28:68, where it says no man shall buy you. That's the same point right there. And no man shall save us out of this captivity.

precepts.why:
I'ma show you right now. Revelation the seventh chapter, just real quick.

“I saw four angels”: These are the four archangels that's set to bring destruction. It's gonna tell you that.

“Holding the four winds of the earth”: Holding the four winds of destruction.

“That the wind should not blow on the earth”: The destructive wind, because the wind is blowing now, so it ain't talking about that kind of wind. The destructive winds should not blow on the earth.

“Nor on the sea”: Because the battleships are on the seas.

“Nor on any tree”: Because when the missiles come, the trees are gonna get burned up.

“And I saw another angel ascending from the east”: And I saw another angel coming from the east.

“Having the seal of the living God”: The seal of the living God is in Isaiah. Give me that real quick, Isaiah 8:16. The seal of the living God is what this other angel came in with, because there was already four angels ready to just destroy, but there was another angel that came in with the seal of the living God. Let's find out what that is.

“Having the seal of the living God”: Having the commandments. That's what he's talking about: having the law, having the seal of the Most High.

“And he cried with a loud voice to the four angels”: And this angel that came with the seal to seal up Israel, this one angel cried to the four angels.

“To whom it was given to hurt the earth”: What was the job of these four angels? To hurt the earth. That's what the job of these four angels was. The angels was to hurt the earth, but one angel stop them.

“To whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea”: So their job was to hurt the earth and the sea.

“Saying, Hurt not the earth”: So this angel coming from the east said what? So this one angel said to these four angels, don't hurt the earth yet. Do not bring the destructive power yet. Hold back the nations that have missile warfare. Don't cause them to press the button yet.

“Neither the sea”: Meaning the battleships, the nuclear submarines, all that. That's what this is talking about.

“Nor the trees”: Because the trees gonna get burned up when those bombs are sent.

“Till we have sealed the servants of our God”: How long? Until we have sealed the servants of our God.

“In their foreheads”: Meaning in their mind. So the Most High was making sure that the Israelites was going to get the commandments, and get, in other words, repent. That's what it's talking about: cause the Israelites to repent. So that's the only reason why this country is still rolling.

“An hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel”: Meaning all Israelites. 12,000 out of every tribe got to get sealed up by that angel that came with the laws of the Most High. That's what this is talking about. When the saints go marching, and that's Israelites. Ain't talking about any other nations; talking about the Israelites. Even the ninth verse is still talking about the scattered Israelites, when they read about coming out of all nations and tongues, because Israel was scattered in all nations, when you read Deuteronomy 28:64, when you read Acts 2 and 5, 1 Peter 1 and 1, all over the scriptures, and Luke. It also talks about that the children of Israel will go into captivity under all nations until the time of the nations be fulfilled. That's what this is talking about here. When that seal is done, when that number's sealed up, that's when the Gentiles' time of rulership is over. That's when the time of the Gentiles shall be fulfilled.

“The number of them which were sealed”: So again, with that being said, there is no way for us to be mad and crazy to think that this is God's utopia. The only reason why this country is still rolling is because that last Israelite has not been sealed up yet. So now you understand why there's such an effort to keep this truth hidden, to keep this truth from getting out, because every member of Israel that gets sealed up, the sand is running out of the hourglass. So this is not the utopia of God. This is going to be destroyed by God. When the Most High get that full set sealed up, it's all over.

“The number of them which were sealed”: So when that last 144,000th member is sealed, that means the one-third of the women, men, babies, all of that, that's Israelites that the Most High is gonna save, they're gonna already be included by the time that last member of the 144,000 is sealed. That means the rest of the one-third is already sealed up. So they're being sealed up as 144,000 is being sealed up. So 12,000 out of each tribe, as they're being sealed up, the Most High sealing up women here, sealing up girls, boys. That's what he's doing. That's what's happening. So when that last one is sealed, the Most High has got the complete number. That's how that goes. And when that's done, he says, I have no more use for Babylon the Great. That's when he's going to say, let those four angels to whom I gave jobs to destroy, now let it loose. That's how that goes.

“Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples”: Seal the law. Among who? Among my disciples, among the Israelites. So that's what we're reading about in the seventh chapter of Revelation. So the Most High, he wants this law sealed in the Israelites, and he got the number recorded there.

Give me Romans 13 and 11, to give you an example on how messed up our people are.

“And that, knowing the time”: This is for you Israelites. This is who this message is for.

“Knowing the time”: My people don't even know what time it is. They see the war going on in Gaza and Israel and the Palestinians and all that, that the Most High is heating this thing up. We don't recognize that the Most High is getting ready to bring devastation on this whole system yet.

“That now it is high time”: Now, today, it is high time. That means the sun is up there. That's what high time means. High time meaning that the sun is 12 o'clock noon.

“For now is our salvation nearer than when we believed”: In other words, it's closer now than it was before, meaning that it's right around the corner. The Most High is ready, just let them angels rip through this whole system.

“The night is far spent”: Meaning this: the sun is up. That's what it says. The night is long gone. It's 12 o'clock noon, but you're groping in darkness. That's what it's talking about.

“Let us therefore cast off the works of darkness”: That's the point there. We're groping around in this darkness, therefore let us cast off the works of darkness.

“And let us put on the armour of light”: The light is the scriptures and the commandments. That's the same thing that it was talking about in Revelation, when it said that bring the law, the seal to seal them up. The commandments is a light, and the law is a lamp, and the commandments is the light. That's how the scripture go.

“For the commandment is a lamp”: That's what Romans was talking about. For the commandments of God is a lamp. This is the same thing that that fifth angel brought to those four angels to whom it was given to hurt the earth.

“And the law is light”: And the laws of God is light. That's what the Most High saying: let us put on the armor of light.

sense.text:
But the Lord shall give thee there a trembling heart: Now, I'm reading these things to, again, to bring you back to the point about the trauma that we face. This is groping around in the dark, groping around in noonday as if it was black, as if we were blind. That's how our people are, and catching complete hell, and living in this situation of hell. We recognize that something is not quite right, and then our conscience begins to beat us. I'm going to go into those things. Our conscience begins to wail on us, like I talked about, I think it was a couple of weeks ago, or maybe have been last week, when I talked about that character in that movie Them, where you had that character that said, what you're gonna do, what you're gonna do. That character is our conscience.

But the Lord shall give thee there a trembling heart: Because the man, what was the name, Mr. Henry, right? Mr. Henry was catching hell. He got cheated out of a job that he should have, he should have owned the damn company. His family was getting all harassed and all of that, and as a man, you feel that there's an obligation for you as a man to control your own destiny, to have some power over your family, to have power over your actions, and all of that was being taken from him. And whenever that happens, your conscience chastises you and say, wait a minute, aren't you a man? Why in the world are you allowing other men to put hell on you like this, and you sitting here comfortably? That's what the conscience would do.

But the Lord shall give thee there a trembling heart: So what we end up doing, so that we don't follow the voice of that conscience, we justify and tell the voice to shut up. We justify the trauma. We say it ain't that bad. And what happens is that when we accept that and justify it, our conscience begins continually to wear on us, till the point where you want to escape reality. Then you get into drugs. Then you get into all kinds of things to take you away: alcoholism. You take on these things to remove you from the reality of knowing that you are not doing the things that a man should do. That's the point there. So that's what that character said to me when I saw that thing in that movie.

But the Lord shall give thee there a trembling heart: But the Lord shall give you Israelites in your captivity a trembling heart. That's the there. And the Lord shall give thee there a trembling, terrorized, traumatized, a living fearful heart. That's what it's talking about. That's how we live and be, and we're supposed to be men, and we're living like feared, scared human beings, and that's going to torment us. Our conscience is going to torment us. That's what this is talking about.

And failing of eyes: Anything you try to envision, it's a failing of eyes. Eyes represent vision. A man is supposed to be able to envisualize his direction, supposed to be able to visualize where he's going to be five years, where he's going to be in 10 years, 15 years. Other nations can do this. We cannot even imagine anything above two weeks, and because of that, what does that do? That forces us to live in the present. That's the perfect mixture for immediate gratifying consumers' gratification, because why should I plan for many years? I might be dead, because I have no control over my future. I don't know my past, because that's been robbed. I don't have any vision for the future. Failing of eyes: I have no vision for the future, so why don't I just live in the present? Whatever I got, let me just spend it on this Jordan's, spending on this, buy this business, and live for the present, live for the moment, what they call the YOLO, you only live once. That kind of mentality is what this is talking about. Then you got people talking about something the Bible ain't affecting them. The Bible is affecting you left and right.

But the Lord shall give thee there a trembling heart: Shall give us this. He shall give us in this captivity a scared, trembling heart.

And failing of eyes: And failing of vision. We have no vision. We can't plan nothing, and it's like a phenomenon for us to even, here we are in IUIC, we say, you know what, we want to do this, we want to do that. Israelites can't even fathom that we are able to do that. A lot of Israelites are underneath this curse. Can't even imagine, can't even see beyond their own nose in terms of vision. They're still under that curse. I pray that they get out of that thing and stop that foolishness.

And sorrow of mind: Meaning that we have no thinking capacity in terms of building. Sorrow of mind: all we see is grief, all we see is a pitiful case. Can't imagine anything beyond that. All this is a curse, and traumatized.

Neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest: Imagine a man that's living and he has no place to rest his head. Neither shall the sole of your foot have rest. You're always on the run. Run to where? Because you have no vision. You can't even say, well, I want to run over there, because you even have no vision. So you just constantly like just running around, a total waste of life. That's how we are. Why? Because we broke the laws of the Most High.

Neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest: And that goes all the way up to now, brothers and sisters that's driving in their cars on these lonely highways. The worst thing that you want is a policeman to pull you over in the total blackness. You're afraid that your battery on your phone might be low. You didn't do anything. It shouldn't be something that you have to think about your life, that you're gonna lose your life over, but you're scared to death. That's not normal, brothers and sisters, and your conscience is telling you that that ain't normal, and you want to tell your conscience to shut up, because it's going to make you question your reality, and it's going to force you to do something. It's going to force you to say, you know what, aren't you a man? Aren't you supposed to control your own destiny? Get up off your lazy butt and get something done. And you want to tell that and say, well, I'm scared, because if I do that, they go kill me. So you have to tell that voice to shut up, and it won't shut up, because there's a spirit in man.

But the Lord shall give thee there a trembling heart: There is a spirit in man. So how do you get it to shut up? Give me that dope, give me that alcohol, give me them pills, give me that marijuana, give me something to take my mind. Give me music, give me holidays, give me church. Give me Sunday church. Some people in there jumping all up, going all crazy. They just as crazy as the rest of us, but when they go in there, they get to push their problems. They push that voice out of their head for the time being. It's Malcolm X, I believe. There was a quote that I saw a long time ago, that Malcolm X referred to the church as a sleeping pill, because that's what it's like. It basically just puts you to sleep from reality. The reality is that conscience, that voice is saying, you know damn well that this ain't right. You as a man, you ain't supposed to live like this.

And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee: On the highway, just like I just got through describing. You're scared to death to get pulled over.

And shalt have none assurance of thy life: You shall have no assurance of your life. Dylann Roof went into a church and killed nine people, and he was not worried about his life at all. George Floyd, a phony twenty dollar bill, rather he knew it was phony or not, he actually had to contemplate death, and was murdered on the streets for a 20 bill. Ain't that something?

And shalt have none assurance of thy life: So what you're going to do when you hear situations like that, and you know doggone well you don't have that kind of privilege, and you're looking at yourself, you say, well, how come they get all the privilege and I don't? It must be my black skin. Let me do like Serena Williams and get rid of this. Maybe I can get rid of this thinking. That's how heavy these things are. That's the trauma that we live with.

In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even: You know what this is saying? We're saying that we have no kind of direction for our lives. Just let me make it to the night.

And at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning: Let me make it to the night, then let me make it to the morning. Let me make it to the night, make it to the morning, because there's no assurance of your life.

And for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see: So the things that we see in this society, there are reminders that our lives are worth nothing, and we're just saying, Lord, just help me make it to the night.

For the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear: In the morning thou shalt say, would God it were even. Could I make it to the evening? Then in the evening, thou shalt say, would God it were morning. Why? Because of the fear of our minds, of what we see, wherein we shall fear. We are afraid. That's how we live. We live in fear, and because we live in fear, it brings a level of reality to us, and instead of living 100 percent in fear, we want to drown it in drugs, drown it in alcohol, drown it in marijuana, because we want to escape it. We drown it. All of the bad habits that we have, even overeating, all of these things is a way to get away from the reality. That's how we live.

In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even: That's exactly what it's saying. That's 12 hours. So again, that points to that point, I'm glad you said that, that points to that point about what I said about being immediate consumers. You can't even fathom the next 12 hours, so why would we save our money to buy a building, or do the stuff that we're trying to do, or to set up departments and stuff, the different things that we do? When you have that kind of mentality, you ain't gonna think nothing beyond your nose. That's why I say a lot of people call themselves Israelites are still up underneath that curse and don't know it, don't realize it, still groping around.

In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even: I say this to my brothers in the Israelite community: I pray to God that you get your mind right and stop this foolishness. Now I will say this here, because there's a lot of brothers that's trying to get themselves there. There's some cats out there that's trying to do right, so I'm not talking about everybody. Let's get that understanding. They have brothers and sisters that's trying to get themselves together, and all praise to the Most High. I pray that we all get ourselves together. I love all of you. I love all of my people Israel.

I will even appoint over you terror: Because you disobeying me. This is what the law is saying. This is where the Most High allowed this system to put this kind of trauma on us, and instead of repenting, we justify the trauma.

Consumption: Meaning we're being destroyed.

And the burning ague: And the burning disease.

That shall consume the eyes: That shall consume our eyes, meaning our vision is done, like we talked about earlier.

And cause sorrow of heart: And cause sorrow of our minds. We can't even envision anything.

And ye shall sow your seed in vain: And everything that we plant to do is in vain. Every little thing that we do, it gets taken away from us. Why? Because we refuse to return unto the Lord.

For your enemies shall eat it: For your enemies shall prosper off of every invention that you make. Everything that you do, they should take it from you.

And I will set my face against you: And because of our disobedience. The Lord said, can two walk together except we agree? We said we don't want to walk with the Lord, so the Lord said, okay, I'm gonna walk with you. So the Lord said what? And I will set my face against you, Israel.

And ye shall be slain before your enemies: And you shall be destroyed before your enemies. Abortions, all of that is because of that thing. 19 million babies, of our babies, destroyed since 1973 up to now. There's many factors that cause it, and ain't just a black woman per se. All of us are complicit in that thing.

They that hate you shall reign over you: The people that hate your guts, Israel. They hate our guts. They hate my guts, so you can understand. They that hate us shall rule over us.

And ye shall flee when none pursueth you: And that's how scared and fearful we are. That's why I've talked about that situation on the highway. You don't want your car to break down in certain parts of town. Hell no, you don't want that. And your car break down, you don't even want to call the police. Just think about that.

They that hate you shall reign over you: Now you're trying to take the rose-colored glasses off of our people. Let's do it. These same systems that you spoke about, they work for everybody else, but for us, they said, well, these systems ain't for you. You're the slaves. You are the fuel that keeps our country rolling, and we need you to be dumb. We need you to be stupid. We need you to be unorganized haters of each other. We need you to be rambunctious, so we can put you in jail, so we can exploit the hell out of you. We don't want you trying to get yourselves together, because if you get yourselves together, how is this country going to survive? Because the engine of this country depends on the fuel of our death. Straight up.

And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me: For all this ugliness that we just read. That's what he's saying.

And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me: If you, after all of this, you don't want to listen to me.

Then I will punish you seven times more for your sins: I will increase your behind whipping seven times. I'm gonna bring seven times more hell on you. That's what the Most High is saying. So this is where we're at, brothers and sisters.

Then I will punish you seven times more for your sins: Now I'm getting ready to get into some things now. We ask for forgiveness, because we're getting torn up. We're asking for the forgiveness. We've asked for the forgiveness in the past. We're asking for the forgiveness now. We ask for forgiveness and reconciliation. We want to reconcile with God. The reason why I wanted to make mention of that is because our Bishop Kani, he did a class, and I called him on it, and I told him that the class was absolutely A1. He did a class last Sabbath, the three o'clock class that we have on our IUIC broadcast, and the name of the class was Forgiveness and Reconciliation.

Then I will punish you seven times more for your sins: And what was so beautiful about that class is that although we, when we mess up, we ask the Lord to forgive us, we also go as far as saying, I want to be able to reconcile with God. And when we do these things, we don't realize that although he'll forgive us, we can get reconciled, but there still comes a judgment, and we don't want the judgment part of it. The judgment is what happened to us. So yes, when Christ came on the scene, during the time of Rome, that was the forgiveness, that was the reconciliation. And what did the disciples and the apostles say? Are thou here now to give us the kingdom? And they said no, because the things which Moses wrote have to be fulfilled. So guess what, the punishment still had to come down. But now we're in a time where our captivity is coming to an end. That's the point that I'm bringing to you now.

Then I will punish you seven times more for your sins: You're 100 correct. But just the fact that you mentioned about the girl with the camera, that's why I talked about the trauma. The trauma was so bad. You heard how she sounded, uncomfortable, what she saw, when she had to see the image that her phone recorded and see this whole image there. She was gasping all over. She was in such trauma, and it brought her right back to the exact point of where she actually watched this man die. She watched George Floyd get murdered, and sat there and watched it.

Then I will punish you seven times more for your sins: The brother, the martial artist, he was so messed up, he called the police on the police, and he told him, this is what he said: I believe I just witnessed the murder. That's on the tape. I believe I just witnessed the murder, not even realizing that what he's saying, he's speaking to the same uniform that's doing the murdering. Imagine what that do to your head.

Then I will punish you seven times more for your sins: So like I said, we now ask for forgiveness and reconciliation, but we still had to get the judgment, and that judgment was ugly. That judgment was ugly. Last week I showed a picture of how this racist country of the eugenics tree, these branches, how they deal with us, which stems from its rotten roots planted in blood-soaked soil. That's what we're looking at here. So this eugenics tree is showing us how all of these systems, like you were saying earlier, there was a point that you was making, I almost forgot the point, about these systems: these systems are set up to sell you as a citizen, supposedly, and have comfort in the fact that these systems, that's what their faculty is for. But for us, it's not the same.

Then I will punish you seven times more for your sins: Now let's focus on this tree, all of these parts that you just talked about. This works for white folks. This works for Esau: mental testing, physical genetics, biology, genealogy, anthropology, geography, law, statistics, politics, economics, biography, genealogy, education, sociology, religion. See that one over there in the corner? Religion. Psychiatry, medicine and surgery. All of these things work for the real citizens, but to us, these things choke us out.

Then I will punish you seven times more for your sins: But I want you to look at the part that says, because what you just said is 100 correct, you see down there in the bottom right corner: religion. How is it that religion helped to choke? Because again, this goes into the trauma, and we in church, we justify false teachings. In church, we justify it. They know that Christ is a black man. How in the world you're going to bring the Bible to the people in church, open it up and read the description of Christ, and the people still say it don't matter? How the hell you gonna say the color of Christ don't matter, when it mattered so much that God had it put in the Bible? But you with your scared selves talking about some color don't matter. Why? Because the voice that's in your head, that what you're gonna do voice, is saying the brothers is right. The brothers are showing you that Christ is black. They're correct. But you with your Christianity, you tell that voice to shut up, and you go right back into the slaughterhouse called church. That's what we're talking about. So that part, religion there, I'm gonna go into a little bit of that. Religion is also one of the roots that strangulates us. That's what I want to talk about.

Then I will punish you seven times more for your sins: So now I want to go back to that part in there that says religion. I want to zero in on that some more. Religion is one of the tools that's used to strangulate the rise of Israel, and that strangulation leads to death. And it's not just a simple, like they're just trying to hold you back from a job. They are literally killing us. That's what these roots are talking about here: killing off our genes to accentuate white folks' genes, and kill off black genes. That's what this whole tree represents. So when Trevor Noah made that statement, he was talking deep. I don't know if he realized it or not, but he said you're not talking about just some bad apples, you talking about a rotten tree. That's what made me go and get this, because that's what he was talking about. So let me give you an example of how eugenics works inside religion. How does the eugenics tree work inside religion?

precepts.why:
Why is the Most High doing this? Because he's trying to afflict us to the point where we return unto him, like it says in Hosea 5:15. That's why it says that there.

“I will go and return to my place”: He said, I will go return to my place until they acknowledge their offense.
